RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

The panel's composition tells you almost nothing here: you and the successful candidate are both women, so sex cannot explain why she was chosen over you. Raising it would look like grievance-hunting and would undermine the much stronger point you actually have.

That point is qualifications and process. On paper you have a master's in educational leadership and five years as deputy principal; she has "courses" and classroom experience. That gap needs explaining — and in most public-sector systems you have a legal right to written reasons within a short, fixed period.

Send a firm follow-up citing that right, with a deadline. If nothing comes, escalate to the relevant oversight body or ombudsman.
